subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR handle legacy no-code orphan diagnostics inside runtime registry loading, or should that upgrade cleanup move to a doctor/migration path before merge?
rationale: The explicit marker fix follows prior direction, but the legacy fallback intentionally changes persisted SQLite fast-path behavior for upgraded users and needs owner acceptance.

options.title: Require latest-head legacy proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds before accepting the runtime fallback.

options.title: Accept source and test proof
options.body: Maintainers can waive the external proof gap and accept the current source proof plus regression tests as enough for this upgrade path.

options.title: Move legacy cleanup out of runtime
options.body: Pause or revise the PR so the no-code legacy row cleanup is handled by doctor or migration-owned repair rather than steady-state registry loading.

recommendation.title: Require latest-head legacy proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds before accepting the runtime fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and is the clearest recent owner for this plugin registry behavior choice.
